pages.text: "I want to sit there too!" Bung pointed at Mom's lap. Ddori already snuggled there. The noodle boat floated calmly, tied to a post.
"Always Ddori on your lap!" Bung pushed the noodle bowl away and sat on a floorboard, back turned.
Mom cut small noodles to feed Ddori. Chews and giggles! Bung's noodles stayed untouched. All steam vanished.
Bung crouched behind an awning post. Only Ddori's laughter came from outside. "Mom only likes Ddori." Bung's nose tingled.
Mom peered behind the post, Ddori in one arm, patting the next board with the other hand. "Here, Bung. This place is empty."
Bung quietly sat. Ddori on Mom's lap, Bung on the board beside her. She put an arm round Bung. "Lap for baby, beside me for Bung."
Now Bung knew it was warm beside Mom. Bung drew Ddori's hand before the knees and smiled. "Beside Mom is my place!"
Mom served fresh, steaming noodles. Bung slurped loudly. Ddori heard and opened the mouth. "Ah!"
Now Bung knew the dinner places. "One, lap for baby! Two, beside Mom for me! Three, slurp side by side!" Lamps came on aboard tied boats.
Mom hugged Ddori in one arm, Bung in the other. Even away from her lap, there was always room beside Mom. Cheek on her shoulder, Bung said, "Beside Mom is my place!"
